name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y $(cat packages.txt) || true; . .venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install streamlit && python download_resources.py && echo '✅ Packages installed and NLTK resources downloaded'
